title: Send retreating and stalemate-breaking entities to region-contained destinations instead of the world origin
summary: Four tactical branches that sent entities to the literal world origin (the is_fleeing gate, the low-HP engaged branch, SAFETY_PRESSURE_RETREAT, STALEMATE_BREAK) now use a region-contained destination: away from threats inside the current region, else home region, else hold; stalemate-break wanders to a seeded nearby in-region point. The ticket listed three branches, there were four. Corpus firing-rate and parked-at-origin measurements (AC-1, AC-4) were not taken.

title: Type an entity-targeted combat objective, resolve it live, and end it when its target dies or leaves perception
summary: ObjectiveState.target_entity_id (typed, omitted from the canonical dict when None) set by CombatEngageScorer; resolves to the live position; the strategic pass and a tier-3 work-queue rule end it when the target dies or leaves the 10-tile radius. On frontier_living_world with only the termination hook toggled, 0 of 13 combat projects were ever terminal vs 37 of 44. Decision-path attack counts did not change (0/0, 5/5). The ticket premise was superseded by the sibling fix and is recorded as a named correction; a first-draft 45 percent dead-target figure is retracted.

title: Give the bravery quartile guard an explicit loud population precondition and the budget it needs
summary: The guard failed locally on a 60s conftest timeout and, with the budget off, at seed 9 (7 live heroes, quartile of 1). Over the 23 populated seeds the bravery ratio is 2.40 against the asserted 1.5, so this was a precondition and budget problem, not a differentiation regression. Seeds that cannot form two-hero quartiles are now excluded and the test skips loudly below 20 qualifying seeds; resource_budget_large added; threshold, spec and src unchanged. Open: why survivors fell below the calibrated floor, and the guard has not run in CI in the last 40 main pushes.

title: Re-measure and characterise the run-to-run divergence that survives audit_mode
summary: Confirmed under audit_mode with a raised budget, zero dropped work and governor mode 0, with a seed-43 positive control and canonical hashes: three of four identical seed-42 runs agree, one diverges from tick 5 (entities 16 and 36; navigation target and project fields). Distinct from INFRA-273, a row-7 hard bug. Proximate mechanism measured: entity 16 strategic-dirty membership changes the tier-7 sweep selection at tick 4; upstream cause is an unproven lead (id()-keyed dedup in src/core/dirty.py). Contradicts the deterministic_execution.md claim about audit_mode. No code changed; fix filed as its own ticket.
